title: Blood Resonance
next_chapter_hook: From the depths of his bloodline, the will of the Demonic Path Commander receded like a tide, yet in the final moment left Chen Ji with information that would keep him sleepless through the night: the Eye of Heavenly Dao was about to awaken, and his time was running out.

text.content: Deep in the night, Chen Ji sat alone in the secret chamber. The truth left behind by the imperial messenger was like a blunt blade, repeatedly tearing at his heart—Chen Nian was the sole key to unlock the Heavenly Fate Treasury, and all of this was merely a chess game the Eye of Heavenly Dao had been orchestrating for a century. The moonlight outside the window was cold and clear, like mercury pouring down. Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, cut his palm with his fingertip, and let a drop of blood fall onto the Jade Pendant that Chen Nian had left when she was young. The pendant suddenly glowed with a faint light, and Chen Ji sensed a familiar blood pulse responding to him from afar—it was Chen Nian, the person he must save in this lifetime.

The sensation of blood resonance grew increasingly vivid. Chen Nian's presence loomed like a distant mountain's silhouette—tender yet indistinct. Suddenly, a jarring consciousness violently intruded, striking like thunder into a tranquil lake—wild, immense, and radiating destructive potential. This wasn't Chen Nian's pulse, but another existence entirely, an entity mysteriously intertwined with his bloodline. Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, pupils contracting to needle points. His palm wound continued to bleed, the crimson droplet hovering eerily in mid-air, transforming into a faint red light that extended through the void toward some distant, unknown coordinate.

Chen Ji's voice echoed through the secret chamber, yet no one answered. The candles inside had been extinguished by some inexplicable force, only the moonlight remained, silver-like on the floor. Chen Ji stared at the suspended blood drop, his brow furrowed tightly, the Tianji Record Fragment within him faintly radiating heat, as if warning him of something. The pulse within his blood remained clear, that strange consciousness like a colossal beast in the abyss, slowly opening its eyes to cast its scrutinizing gaze upon him. Chen Ji felt an intangible pressure envelop his entire being—this was a might comparable to the Eye of Heavenly Dao—the Demonic Path Commander was, after all, so incredibly powerful.

Then, an aged yet authoritative voice rang directly in his mind, like a great bell resonating, shaking his eardrums painfully: 'You and I are one, twin fates, cast aside by heaven.' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, his knuckles white from gripping tightly. These eight words exploded in his consciousness like thunder, and he had never imagined that one day he would have any connection to the Demonic Path Commander—that slaughterer of all living beings, the demon intent on destroying the three realms. Yet the connection in his blood was so unmistakable, leaving him no room for denial. Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down, countless thoughts racing through his mind: the Tianji Record, twin fates, the Eye of Heavenly Dao... what was the connection between all this?

Chen Ji coldly rebutted, his voice hard as iron. Yet the resonance from the depths of his bloodline surged like a tide, preventing him from completely denying the other's existence. That consciousness seemed to sense his resistance and let out a low, mocking laugh—a laughter carrying boundless vicissitudes and desolation: 'Your sister? Hah, she is merely a strand of my soul that was separated. A century ago, the Eye of Heavenly Dao discovered I possessed the power to foresee the future, feared I would shake its rule, and thus split me into two—one part became the pages in your hands, the other was sealed as the Demonic Path Commander.' Chen Ji felt a intense vertigo, the Tianji Record Fragment within him faintly aching, as if corroborating these words. He had never imagined that the connection between himself and the Demonic Path Commander ran so deep.

dialogue.content: Even if it's true, so what? The Eye of Heavenly Dao wants to use me—why should I help you?

text.content: Chen Ji's tone was cold as frost, his fingers gripping the Jade Pendant so tightly its edges nearly embedded into his palm. The consciousness within his blood fell silent for a moment, then a vast torrent of information flooded into Chen Ji's mind—it was the truth about the Eye of Heavenly Dao, the blood and tears history of prophets being used as chess pieces through the ages, and the catastrophic disaster about to befall this world. Chen Ji saw countless scenes: prophets through the ages being manipulated by the Eye of Heavenly Dao, ultimately becoming discarded pieces; every master of the Tianji Record meeting a tragic end; and this time, it was his turn. Chen Ji's fists slowly clenched, knuckles cracking. Even knowing the abyss lay ahead, he would not retreat, because Chen Nian was still waiting for him there.

The consciousness's voice suddenly became solemn, like a divine decree descending: 'I am not asking you to help me. I am telling you a secret—the Eye of Heavenly Dao is our common enemy. It has been laying plans for a hundred years, using all of us as chess pieces, including your sister Chen Nian, including me, and including you. The Tianji Record in your hands is merely one of the many chess pieces it has placed.' Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted, yet the pulse within his blood grew ever clearer. He could sense the sincerity of that consciousness—a kind of tranquility after all the hardships, a release after seeing through everything. However, Chen Ji would not easily believe anyone, even if what was said was true.

dialogue.content: Chen Nian is my sister. Even if she is part of you, I will not let her become anyone's chess piece. Tell me, what exactly has the Eye of Heavenly Dao done to her?

text.content: The consciousness within his blood fell into a long silence, as if reminiscing over some long-buried past. After a long while, its voice rang out again, carrying a hint of weariness and release: 'Chen Nian... she is a wisp of essence that scattered when I was split apart, falling into the mortal world to become your sister. She inherited part of my power—the ability to disrupt the Tianji Record's foresight. And the Eye of Heavenly Dao had long calculated this, which is why it began its布局 a hundred years ago. Her being taken by the Holy Sect is precisely so that one day her blood could be used to open the Heavenly Fate Treasury.' Upon hearing this, a cold light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's conspiracy was even more sinister than he had imagined, and he was but a piece on the chessboard, manipulated from beginning to end.
Then so what?

choice.prompt: Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, the wound on his palm already healed, leaving only a faint scar. Faced with this shocking truth, he needed to make a choice:

choices.text: Demand the other party prove their sincerity
choices.description: Empty words are worthless; if there is genuine desire for cooperation, practical actions must be taken to prove it
choices.visible_cost: There may be further consumption of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial intelligence about the Eye of Heavenly Dao's weaknesses
choices.risk_hint: The other party may sever the connection due to lack of trust

text.content: Chen Ji's voice was cold as a blade's edge: 'Empty words are worthless. If you truly wish to cooperate, tell me the Eye of Heavenly Dao's weakness.' The consciousness within his blood fell silent for a moment, then let out a low laugh: 'Good, worthy of being the one chosen by the Tianji Record. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's weakness lies in its three great Heavenly Fate Altars—each altar requires a prophet's sacrifice to operate. A century ago, it framed me to obtain the sacrifice for the first altar. And Chen Nian is precisely the sacrifice for the second altar.'

choices.text: Question the meaning of twin fates
choices.description: Since we are twin fates, what exactly is the relationship between us? Why was there no resonance before?
choices.visible_reward: Understanding the essence of fate twins' bond, obtaining the rudimentary form of blood resonance ability
choices.risk_hint: May shake one's inner recognition of self-identity

text.content: Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly, the fluctuation in his blood pulsing like tides: "Fate twins... then what exactly is the relationship between us? Why has there never been any resonance before?" The consciousness sighed, its voice carrying a hint of bitterness: "Because the Tianji Record Fragment in your possession is incomplete. Only when two fragments appear in the same time and space simultaneously will the fate twin bond be activated. And tonight, this is the first time you have triggered the power of both fragments—one within you, one here with me."

choices.description: Cooperation is possible, but protecting Chen Nian must be the primary premise, any action that harms her is unacceptable
choices.visible_reward: Establish preliminary trust with the Demonic Path commander, obtaining crucial clues regarding Chen Nian's whereabouts
choices.risk_hint: The other party may think you are creating obstacles

text.content: Chen Ji's voice was calm yet unquestionable: "Cooperation is possible, but I have one condition—I will not participate in any action that might harm Chen Nian." The consciousness within his bloodline fell silent for a moment, then emitted a low chuckle: "Very well. She is now imprisoned in the depths of the Forbidden Grounds of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, guarded by the three great elders of the Holy Sect. If you wish to rescue her, you must first gather three Heavenly Fate artifacts to unseal the forbidden grounds."

Chen Ji opened his eyes, the resonance in his bloodline slowly fading like the aftertaste left by receding tides. He lowered his gaze to the jade pendant in his palm—the faint glow had dimmed, yet the power contained within filled him with unprecedented shock. The Tianji Record Fragment in his body warmed slightly, as if responding to the conversation. Chen Ji took a deep breath, calming the turbulent waves in his heart. He stood up, walked to the window, and gazed at the cold bright moon in the night sky. Regardless of whether the Demonic Path commander spoke truth or falsehood, one thing was certain—the Heavenly Eye was his true enemy, and he must grow stronger to protect those he wishes to safeguard.

However, just at this moment, an intense fluctuation suddenly arose from within his bloodline—that was the Demonic Path commander's consciousness emerging again, carrying unprecedented urgency. Chen Ji frowned, sensing a dangerous aura approaching—the Heavenly Eye's will, which seemed to have detected tonight's blood resonance. Immediately, an ancient and authoritative voice exploded within his mind: "It has awakened. Be careful, the Heavenly Eye's consciousness has begun to infiltrate... You must find the three Heavenly Fate artifacts quickly, otherwise the next foresight will be the death of us both." Before the voice finished, the connection within his bloodline abruptly severed, as if forcibly cut by some powerful force.

The air in the secret chamber seemed to freeze, Chen Ji felt an invisible pressure engulfing his entire body—that was the Heavenly Eye's will probing him. His Tianji Record Fragment vibrated violently, as if warning him. Chen Ji gritted his teeth, true qi circulating through his body, forcibly suppressing the anomaly of the Tianji Record. He knew the Heavenly Eye had already taken notice of him, and from this moment on, he must be even more careful. Yet his eyes held no trace of fear—instead, a sharp gleam flashed through them. Since the Heavenly Eye had set its sights on him, he would show this so-called Heavenly Way who truly was the chess piece.

choice.prompt: Blood resonance ceased abruptly, and the threat of the Heavenly Eye hung like a sword over his head. Chen Ji must make a decision within limited time:

choices.text: Immediately search for the first Heavenly Fate artifact
choices.description: Time is pressing, must act before the Heavenly Eye locks onto himself
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key resources first, winning the initiative to rescue Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: May encounter traps set by the Heavenly Eye

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no more, turning to walk toward a stone wall deep within the secret chamber. His fingers traced complex patterns across the wall, and the stone wall slowly cracked open, revealing a dark passage. That was the secret inheritance site left by generations of Tianqing Sect masters—the fragment of the Heavenly Fate Mirror, the first Heavenly Fate artifact, hidden within. Chen Ji stepped into the dark passage, his footsteps echoing in the silence. He knew from this moment on, he had officially embarked on the path of confronting the Heavenly Eye. Ahead lay unknown dangers, but his eyes held only determination.

choices.text: First seek Ye Qing to discuss strategies
choices.description: Demonic mist can conceal the Tianji Record's spiritual energy, must rely on her power
choices.visible_reward: Gain Ye Qing's trust and obtain strategic-level assistance
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may have complex reactions regarding the matter of fate twins

text.content: Chen Ji took out a black transmission jade talisman from his怀, that was the secret contact method between him and Ye Qing. The jade talisman warmed slightly, Chen Ji briefly transmitted tonight's discoveries into it. After a moment, the jade talisman vibrated, and Ye Qing's voice rang in his mind, carrying a hint of barely concealable shock: "Fate twins... I should have guessed long ago. The Demonic Path commander's power shares the same source as the Tianji Record, so that's how it is. Chen Ji, tomorrow at the hour of the horse, meet at the old place." Ye Qing's voice revealed complex emotions—surprise at the truth, and a certain recognition of Chen Ji.

choices.text: Use the Tianji Record to foresee the next move
choices.description: Insufficient information, need to foresee the trend of the next three hours to make the optimal choice
choices.visible_reward: Obtain a crucial foresight fragment, evade the lethal danger in advance
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is precious to begin with, after consumption the situation becomes even more perilous

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, immersing his consciousness into the Tianji Record Fragment. After a moment, a hazy light and shadow appeared before his eyes—that was the foresight of the next three hours. Within the vision, he saw a blurry figure approaching his residence, an Inner Disciple of the Tianqing Sect who seemed to bring urgent news. Farther away, he also witnessed a chilling scene: Chen Nian trapped within a massive formation, with the Heavenly Eye's will eroding her consciousness. Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, a fierce killing intent flickering in his gaze. The time remaining was more urgent than he had imagined.

Night deepened, and Chen Ji stood before the window of the secret chamber, gazing into the distant dark night sky. Countless thoughts churned in his heart: the Heavenly Eye, the twins of destiny, the three Heavenly Fate artifacts, Chen Nian's safety... All of these were like interwoven threads, binding him tightly. Yet Chen Ji's face showed no sign of panic; a faint, cold smile even appeared at the corner of his mouth. From the day he transmigrated to this world, he had never yearned for a fair destiny. Since the heavens wished to toy with him, he would drag this heaven and earth down from its divine altar.

At this moment, a soft knock came from outside the secret chamber, and a low voice spoke: 'Senior brother, there are urgent matters that need to be reported.' Chen Ji furrowed his brows slightly. He recognized this voice—it belonged to an Inner Disciple of the Tianqing Sect, responsible for patrolling the sect's forbidden grounds. He took a deep breath, steadied his emotions, and wore his usual timid expression as he slowly walked toward the door. Opening it, Chen Ji saw a young disciple in blue robes standing outside, anxiety written across his face. The moment the disciple saw Chen Ji, he quickly said: 'Senior Brother Chen, the Sect Master has ordered you to immediately go to the Council Hall.' Chen Ji blinked, looking bewildered: 'The Sect Master wants to see me? What happened?' A subtle hint of oddity flickered across the disciple's face: 'It seems to be... regarding the Demonic Path invasion.'

Chen Ji nodded, following behind the disciple with a calm expression, yet his heart was icy cold. Tianqing Sect's Sect Master Ling Yuan, the old fox who superficially sheltered him but harbored malicious intentions, summoning him at this critical moment was no coincidence. He recalled the warning from the Demonic Path commander during the bloodline resonance—the Heavenly Eye had awakened, and its consciousness was infiltrating. Chen Ji's fingers tightened subtly in his sleeve, fingertips already gripping a concealed talisman. If Ling Yuan had truly been controlled by the Heavenly Eye, he had to prepare for the worst. The night wind swept through the corridor, emitting a mournful wail, and Chen Ji's footsteps echoed on the empty stone road, like a countdown of destiny.
